verdict.rationale: Datadog documents its own API Reference at docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/ and offers a markdown version for AI agents, so a first-party API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or has runnable examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at the common paths. missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it/runnable request examples, code samples per endpoint, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: For AI agents: A markdown version of this page is available at https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest.md
